comment: Cut out every photo in photos/ with the in-app matting model and save each as a PNG with transparency in cutouts/. Needs a matting model under Settings > Helpers (BiRefNet lite is the small one); without one the background removal of a connected ComfyUI with comfyui-rmbg runs instead. From the folder that holds photos/: Scumble --run cutout_folder.json (docs/MCP.md, Batches).

steps.comment: a tab of its own: the run never changes the documents you have open
the photo once more, as a layer: the background is removed from a layer
